question: According to the Report of the Technical Group on Population Projections (July 2020), India's elderly population is expected to reach ________ million by 2031.
solution:
The correct answer is __**113.4 million**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The **Report of the Technical Group on Population Projections** (July 2020), published by the **National Commission on Population** under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, estimates that **India's elderly population** (aged 60 years and above) will reach **113.4 million by 2031**. 
• This projection highlights a significant increase compared to the elderly population of approximately **104 million in 2021**, indicating the growing demographic trend of aging in India. 
• India's elderly population is expected to constitute around **8.9% of the total population** by 2031, showcasing the need for enhanced policies related to healthcare, social security, and financial assistance. 
• The increase in the elderly population is attributed to factors such as improved **life expectancy**, advances in healthcare, and declining fertility rates.
